title: An algebraic zero-dimensional scheme over a field is affine and finite
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $Y$ be a scheme of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] with $\dim Y\le0$ [def-pc-dimension]. Then $Y$ is affine [def-pc-scheme], and the structure morphism $Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism].

proof.text: Use [lem-pc-scheme-dimension-local-rings] to rewrite dim Y <= 0 as topologicalKrullDim Y <= 0. Apply the Mathlib declarations of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-dim-zero-artinian]: locally finite type over Spec k gives IsLocallyNoetherian Y, hence the dimension bound gives IsLocallyArtinian Y. Quasi-compactness over the compact Spec k gives CompactSpace Y. Local Artinianity supplies DiscreteTopology Y, and compactness plus discreteness gives Finite Y.
Apply the finite-discrete affineness instance recorded in [lem-weil-pbc-finite-discrete-scheme-affine] to obtain IsAffine Y.

Write R = Gamma(Spec k, O) and B = Gamma(Y, O), with the algebra structure induced by the structure morphism on global sections. The affine-pair criterion HasRingHomProperty.iff_of_isAffine for LocallyOfFiniteType gives Algebra.FiniteType R B directly (Stacks Tag 01T2). Local Artinianity and affineness give IsArtinianRing B, and Spec k is Artinian so IsArtinianRing R. In particular Ring.KrullDimLE 0 B. This avoids a separate dimension computation from an affine cover and avoids transporting the algebra structure across Gamma(Spec k) = k.

Apply the Mathlib declaration Module.finite_iff_krullDimLE_zero recorded in [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra-dim-zero-finite], with Artinian base ring R, to obtain Module.Finite R B. The affine criterion HasAffineProperty.iff_of_isAffine for IsFinite identifies this with finiteness of Y -> Spec k. The zero ring B and the empty scheme are included throughout.
